landing.headline: Job-ready estimates from photos emailed to you.
landing.subhead: Clients open your link, chat with AI, share photos, and your Word estimate lands in your inbox. No client accounts. No chasing details.
landing.how1Body: Your admin sets up your account and gives you a client link like /c/CTR-XXXXX. Send it to customers.
landing.how2Body: Clients open your link, describe the job, and upload photos. No login and no code to type.
landing.how3Body: When details are complete, a Word estimate is generated and emailed only to you ready to review and send.
landing.forContractorsBody: Share your link with clients. Painting, roofing, and flooring estimates in English or Spanish.
landing.forClientsBody: Open the link your contractor sent you, describe the job, and chat — they’ll get the report.
landing.trustLine: Built for US contractors who want faster, clearer estimates.

portal.disabledBody: Contractor accounts are created by the admin. If you are a contractor, use the client link you were given to share with customers.

auth.registerSubtitle: Start your 7-day free trial. Get your public code instantly. Reports and emails use your preferred language.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your Contractor Estimator account.
auth.name: Full name

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.codeHint: Share this code with clients so they can request estimates.
dashboard.codeNotReady: Not ready to receive requests. Activate your trial or subscription.
dashboard.licenseOptionalHint: Optional. JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF. Not required to receive requests.

blockReason.subscription_inactive: Your trial or subscription is inactive. Subscribe to continue receiving requests.

dashboard.billingHint: After trial, subscribe to keep receiving estimate requests.
dashboard.emptyRequests: No sent estimates yet. Share your code with clients to get started.

estimate.title: Request an estimate
estimate.subtitle: Tell us about the job. We’ll chat to gather details, then send a report to your contractor.
estimate.locationHint: City and area, e.g. Austin, TX
estimate.descriptionHint: What needs to be done? Approximate size, condition, timeline…
estimate.successBody: Your estimate report was sent to your contractor.
estimate.failedBody: We couldn’t finish this estimate. Please try again or contact your contractor.
estimate.failedRetryHint: You can send another message to try again.
estimate.blockedGeneric: This contractor is not available or not active. Please check the link or contact them.
estimate.linkRequiredBody: Open the estimate link your contractor sent you (for example /c/CTR-XXXXX). You don’t enter a contractor code yourself.
estimate.invalidLinkBody: This contractor link looks incomplete. Ask your contractor for a fresh link.
estimate.unknownLinkBody: This link doesn’t match a contractor account. Check the URL or ask your contractor for a new link.

billing.successBody: Thanks! Your billing is set up. You can return to your dashboard.
billing.cancelBody: No charge was made. You can subscribe anytime from your dashboard.
